g.text: MEASURED QPU DATA / 16 PUBs × 8,192 SHOTS / 40 s CHARGED

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8656a1

g.text: ODD LABELS REVERSE THE REPLAY RESIDUAL

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23323b

g.text: No-feedback s1 / s3 lie +13.46 / +10.42 pp above replay; the other 14 outcomes lie below replay. A uniform subtractive success penalty misses that pattern.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596a75

g.text: Inference: Hoeffding + union bound; 12-family α = 0.05; half-width 4.0945 pp. Independent stationary repetitions within each PUB are required.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596a75

g.text: Within-shot and cross-PUB dependence are unrestricted by the bound. PUBs remain unpaired. Delay intervals include zero; equivalence is untested.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596a75

g.text: Confounds: coherent routing / terminal writer differ (69 CZ, q94 versus 72 CZ, q93); the two jobs ran in separate windows. Odd no-feedback ideal contrast is −50 pp.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596a75

g.text: Delay replaces early measurement / feedback with calibrated delay and known-label unconditional correction; reset remains. These comparisons change several mechanisms.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596a75
